description: Creates a Docmino document with MDX content and an optional nested page tree, returning its ID, canonical link, and metadata. Omit workspaceId for your account and projectId for an ungrouped document. It does not publish or invite recipients; use publish_document or invite_share separately. Supported interactive component syntax and examples are available from get_authoring_guide.

children.description: Nested child pages in display order. Preserve existing IDs, hierarchy, and order unless the user requests changes.

content.description: Raw Docmino MDX body without code fences, <mdx> wrappers, or chat metadata. Supported interactive component syntax and examples are available from get_authoring_guide.

id.description: Existing page ID when retaining or updating a page. Omit for a new page.

slug.description: Page URL segment; preserve the existing value when retaining a page.

content.description: Raw Docmino MDX body without code fences, <mdx> wrappers, or chat metadata. Supported interactive component syntax and examples are available from get_authoring_guide.

id.description: Stable client-generated ID for creation retries; omit for a server-generated ID.

name.description: Document title; omit on updates to retain its current title.

pages.description: Complete nested page tree in display order. Omit to preserve all pages; when supplied, existing pages missing from this tree are deleted and require mcp:delete. An empty array removes all child pages.

projectId.description: Project ID returned by list_projects, get_project, or create_project.

slug.description: Document URL segment; omit on updates to preserve its current slug.

summary.description: Short document summary used in search and previews; omit on updates to preserve it.

tags.description: User-controlled document tags. Omit unless the user explicitly requests a tag change; omitting this field preserves existing tags on updates.

workspaceId.description: Personal account or organization ID returned by list_workspaces. Omit when optional to use your personal account.

name: create_document
title: Create Document
